verdict.rationale: Wise documents a first-party webhook subscription API. Partners can create, list, retrieve and delete subscriptions at both application and profile level and test their endpoints. A downloadable OpenAPI spec for the Webhook Sender API and a sandbox Simulation API for webhook test flows back this up. missing for 10: documented event-type catalog, delivery details such as signature verification and retries, webhooks being covered by the versioning policy, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Manage webhook subscriptions at both the application and profile level. Create, list, retrieve, and delete subscriptions, as well as test your webhook endpoints.
Wise publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document ("## Download OpenAPI description") for its Webhook Sender API
paired with a Simulation API for driving money-movement and webhook test flows
